evidence_notice: These values are editorial priors supplied for system initialization, not measurements of named creators or downloaded public videos.
replacement_requirement: Replace or recalibrate numerical priors only after annotation of user-owned or properly licensed footage, retaining sample size, distribution, and provenance.

confidence_scale.medium: usable as a bounded starting range

meaningful_visual_changes_per_min.definition: A motivated change in shot, crop, proof overlay, readable graphic, or game-state presentation; decorative flicker does not count.

stylized_transitions.allowed_condition: Matched directional motion or a real action/state transition.

hard_gates: transcript or timeline timing must be measurable
supported hook must start no later than 12 seconds
no unsupported or fabricated gameplay, UI, result, logo, quote, or evidence
stylized transitions must be motivated by matched direction or a real action/state change
critical HUD and action must remain readable
